ignore.reason: echo v4 has no fix (fixed in v5). Only affects echo.New() without Echo#IPExtractor; the server sets IPExtractor explicitly (cmd/shared/server.go), so the rate limiter does not trust a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For
echo v4 has no fix (fixed in v5). Only affects echo's proxy middleware, which the server does not use

Weak mask key only matters for a WebSocket client behind a caching proxy. The server only accepts connections (Upgrader) and never dials one, and servers do not mask frames. Fix exists only as an untagged commit after v1.5.3
